_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: ACCA syllabus and study guides for the three Applied Knowledge papers: Business and Technology (BT/FBT), Management Accounting (MA/FMA) and Financial Accounting (FA/FFA), Session 2025-2026 (S25-A26) editions, accaglobal.com
_items_source.version: Session 2025-2026 (S25-A26) syllabus and study guide editions, the current versions linked from accaglobal.com, fetched live 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: Ids use ACCA's own syllabus heading letters and numbers for each paper (BT.A1-BT.F4; MA.A1-MA.F4; FA.A1-FA.I3), prefixed with the paper code so ids are unique across the combined course.
